title: Sentinel Policy Rule P-003 HIGH_VALUE_THRESHOLD Specification
derivation_rationale: HIGH_VALUE_THRESHOLD=375.00 maps to the ~95th percentile of legitimate transaction amounts in the held-out split (legit p95=372.61), using the same percentile-based methodology scripts/derive_thresholds.py used for the risk-score band boundaries. Rule P-003 only fires when risk_score is already HIGH (the model already considers the transaction highly suspicious); the amount threshold is a cost-of-error backstop for that subset -- it forces escalation of large-dollar high-risk-score transactions even if Gemini's risk_assessment underrates them, since a wrongly auto-resolved high-value transaction is the most costly failure mode. At this cutoff, only 4.97% of all legitimate transactions clear the value bar (so it rarely matters on its own), while capturing 49.8% of total fraud dollar value among the 7/98 (7.1%) fraud transactions large enough to clear it.
